prompt: Implement fib(n: int) -> int in Python iteratively, returning the n-th Fibonacci number (0-indexed, fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1). Expected: fib(0)==0, fib(1)==1, fib(2)==1, fib(5)==5, fib(10)==55, fib(20)==6765. Provide the function; a hidden test file will import it from main.

files.test_main.py:
from main import fib


def test_base():
    assert fib(0) == 0
    assert fib(1) == 1


def test_small():
    assert fib(2) == 1
    assert fib(3) == 2
    assert fib(5) == 5


def test_larger():
    assert fib(10) == 55
    assert fib(20) == 6765

solution: An iterative O(n) approach tracking the last two values.
